_about: The S3 stand-in's identities for test_s3_connector_live.py (L1.9 part 1): synthetic test credentials, never a real key (rule 9). 'setup' writes the fixture objects; 'reader' may only list and read synthetic-exports, as the namespace's role would; 'other' may read only another bucket, so a read of synthetic-exports is refused as access denied.
